Fees.description:
Use to check fees.

If using in tandem with `AVS` query string, append `?Fees+AVS` or `?AVS+Fees` to your URL.

enhancedResponse.name: enhancedResponse
enhancedResponse.description: Provides more granular detail in 3DS responses.

RejectDuplicateCard.name: RejectDuplicateCard
RejectDuplicateCard.description:
Use to disallow account creation if an account with card already exists

Incompatible with query string `OKToAddDuplicateCard`. All requests must use `RejectDuplicateCard` or `OKToAddDuplicateCard` if using [Duplicate Card Check](https://developers.tabapay.com/reference/how-to-use-duplicate-card-check#).
Use is allowed if <<glossary:Version>> is `v1` (not `v2`)

OKToAddDuplicateCard.name: OKToAddDuplicateCard
OKToAddDuplicateCard.description:
Use to allow account creation if an account with card already exists

Incompatible with query string `RejectDuplicateCard`. All requests must use `OKToAddDuplicateCard` or `RejectDuplicateCard` if using [Duplicate Card Check](https://developers.tabapay.com/reference/how-to-use-duplicate-card-check#/).
Use is allowed if <<glossary:Version>> is `v1` (not `v2`)

OKToUpdateDuplicateCard.name: OKToUpdateDuplicateCard
OKToUpdateDuplicateCard.description:
Use to allow account update if an account with card already exists

Incompatible with query string `RejectDuplicateCard`. Update requests must use `OKToUpdateDuplicateCard` or `RejectDuplicateCard` if using [Duplicate Card Check](https://developers.tabapay.com/reference/how-to-use-duplicate-card-check#/).
Use is allowed if <<glossary:Version>> is `v1` (not `v2`)

authorize.name: authorize
authorize.description:
Note the query string, `?authorize`, will create an authorization only. For `pull` payments. To settle the transaction, you must call [Capture Transaction](/reference/transactioncapture). 

 Request to enable [Auth & Capture](/docs/overview-of-auth#/) at [TabaPay Support](https://tabapay.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/requests/new#/) or [help@tabapay.com](mailto:help@tabapay.com)

reversal.name: reversal
reversal.description:
Use for reversing a transaction. (i.e. if Delete Transaction Request is *after* settlement of original *pull* transaction.)

Required to use `void` or `reversal` on every pull transaction DELETE request (non RTP).

Request to enable [Multiple Reversals](/docs/multiple-reversals#/) at [TabaPay Support](https://tabapay.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/requests/new#/) or [help@tabapay.com](mailto:help@tabapay.com)

void.name: void
void.description:
Use for voiding a transaction. (i.e. if Delete Transaction request is *before* settlement of original *pull* transaction.)

**Note**: When reversing a transaction with status: `AUTHOIRZED`, you must use the `?void` parameter. Required to use `void` or `reversal` on every pull transaction DELETE request (non RTP).

RTPRequest.name: request
RTPRequest.description:
Use if you are sending a Request for Return of Funds (regarding the original RTP-Credit Transfer).

Must use `request` or `response`

RTPResponse.name: response
RTPResponse.description:
Use if you are responding to a Request for Return of Funds (regarding a received RTP-Credit Transfer).

*Must use `response` or `request`*
